args.sql:
SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS user_id,
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    CAST(sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount' AS integer) AS follower_count,
    CAST(sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval' AS integer) AS viral_content_count,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (CAST(sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount' AS numeric) / 100.0 
         * (e.engrate * 2) 
         * (CAST(sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval' AS numeric) + 1) 
         * 0.5) AS numeric), 2) AS social_influence_multiplier,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount' AS integer) > 500
             AND ROUND(CAST(
                (CAST(sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount' AS numeric) / 100.0 
                 * (e.engrate * 2) 
                 * (CAST(sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval' AS numeric) + 1)
